decision.reason: Fast one-3090 operation plus causal prompted endpoint shifts in all six matched pairs and two clean counterfactual successes.
decision.secondary_role: Stronger semantic imagined-future comparison and a promising fine-tuning substrate; default swaps are not yet successful.

efficient_wam.claim_limit: One expert-valid bell/bread scene; scene transfer remains unmeasured.

fastwam.implementation_finding: The release accepted text_cfg_scale but did not apply CFG in action-only or joint inference.

lingbot_va.memory_fix: Share one frozen VAE weight set across two independent streaming-cache wrappers.
lingbot_va.evaluation_fix: Run one episode per subprocess because CuRobo CUDA-graph pools survive environment close.

claim: Efficient-WAM-RT is a usable research WAM for matched language-steering experiments, not a generally reliable language controller.
